title: Centrifugal force EXIST nahi karta
description: Season 2 Episode 13: Nothing throws you outward; you keep going straight while the car turns under you. The only real force is inward — centripetal.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 4 & 5 (uniform circular motion, centripetal force)
exam_focus: JEE: pseudo forces, banking of roads; NEET: centripetal force
hook_text: Gaadi mudti hai, tum bahar 'phenke' jaate ho — yeh force JHOOTH hai 🚗
concept: Nothing throws you outward; you keep going straight while the car turns under you. The only real force is inward — centripetal.
on_screen_cues: top view: car turns left, passenger's straight dotted path → "Real force = CENTRIPETAL (inward) = mv²/r" → "Centrifugal = pseudo force (rotating frame only)" → "NCERT XI Ch 4/5"
pinned_comment: Washing machine ke kapde deewar pe kaise chipakte hain — centrifugal ya centripetal? Explain karo, best answer pin hoga 📌
suggested_titles: "Centrifugal force exist nahi karta 🤯" / "Gaadi mudne pe tum bahar kyun jaate ho? Asli reason"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confidently] Chintu, gaadi left mudti hai aur main right side door pe ja lagti hoon. Koi force mujhe bahar phenkta hai!
Chintu: [deadpan] Koi force nahi hai.
Gudiya: [sarcastic] Toh main door pe kaise pahunchi?!
Chintu: [mischievously] Tum door pe nahi pahunchi... door tumhare paas aaya!
Gudiya: [confused] Kya?!
Chintu: [excited] Newton ka first law yaad hai? Chalti cheez SEEDHI chalti rehti hai!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh gaadi mudi... aur main seedhi chalti rahi?
Chintu: [elated] EXACTLY! Tum seedha ja rahi thi. Gaadi left mudi. Door tumse takraya. Tumhe laga tum bahar gayi!
Gudiya: [surprised] Toh asli force kaunsa hai?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Sirf ek. Door tumhe ANDAR ki taraf push karta hai, taaki tum bhi mudo. Isko CENTRIPETAL force bolte hain. Centre ki taraf.
Gudiya: [curious] Aur centrifugal?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh sirf feeling hai. Gaadi ke andar se dekhne pe lagta hai. Bahar khade insaan ko sirf tumhara seedha jaana dikhta hai.
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Matlab jab bhi cheez circle mein ghoomti hai, koi usse andar kheench raha hota hai... bahar koi nahi phenkta!
Chintu: [proudly] Balti ka paani, Moon, washing machine ke kapde... sab centripetal!
Gudiya: [elated] Toh "bahar phenkne wala force" ek illusion hai!
Chintu: [cheerfully] JEE mein isko PSEUDO force bolte hain. Yaad rakho.
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, maine 1 ghanta deewar ko dhakela. Kitna kaam kiya?
Chintu: [deadpan] Zero. Woh next video mein!
